source.author: verg
source.text: Ante etiam sceptrum Dictaei regis et ante inpia quam caesis gens est epulata iuvencis, aureus hanc vitam in terris Saturnus agebat; necdum etiam audierant inflari classica, necdum inpositos duris crepitare incudibus enses.
source.text_original: Ante etiam sceptrum Dictaei regis et ante / inpia quam caesis gens est epulata iuvencis, / aureus hanc vitam in terris Saturnus agebat; / necdum etiam audierant inflari classica, necdum / inpositos duris crepitare incudibus enses.
source.text_english: Even before the scepter of the Dictean king, and even before the impious race feasted on slaughtered calves, golden Saturn was living out this life on earth; nor had they yet heard trumpets blown, nor swords ringing, placed upon the hard anvils.
